dependencies.dependency: org.springframework.boot spring-boot-starter-web // For building web applications, including RESTful services
org.springframework.boot spring-boot-starter-thymeleaf // For server-side rendering of HTML templates
org.springframework.boot spring-boot-starter-data-jpa // For integrating Spring Data JPA, which simplifies database access and ORM (We will be utilizing SQLite as our database)
org.xerial sqlite-jdbc // JDBC driver for SQLite, allowing our application to connect to and interact with the SQLite database 3.45.2.0
org.hibernate.community hibernate-sqlite // Hibernate dialect for SQLite, enabling Hibernate to generate appropriate SQL queries for SQLite databases 6.4.4.Final

org.springframework.boot spring-boot-starter-test // For testing support, including JUnit, Mockito, and Spring TestContext Framework. (Will likely use JUnit and Mockito alone, unsure yet) YES UNIT TESTING IS A MUST test

build.plugins: maven-compiler-plugin // Configures the Java compiler settings, such as the source and target Java versions
